newsitem.title: USA: The Right Start to slow new store growth.
newsitem.headline: The Right Start to slow new store growth.

text.p: The Right Start Inc said it would slow its rate of new store growth and review current plans that call for 30 new stores in the year ending January 31, 1998.

The company said in a statement that "due to the recent rapid growth ... management believes that this is an appropriate time to slow new store development and to make certain enhancements to its merchandising strategy and operating systems." It gave no further explanation.
The company, which operates 37 retail stores and a mail order catalog offering products for infants and young children, currently has four new stores under development.
